words.stale: The draft changed since you read it. Read it again and edit from the new version.
words.frozen: This draft is frozen for approval. Ask its owner to unfreeze it before you change it.
words.not_an_author: This person is not one of the draft's authors.
words.not_owner: Only the draft's owner can do this.
words.not_your_section: You can change only your own section of the draft.
words.no_draft: There is no draft to edit.
words.no_change: Nothing changed, so there is nothing to save.
words.bad_field: Only title, body, pictures and your own section can be changed.
words.approval_stale: Your approval is for an older version of the draft. Read the draft and approve the version you read.
